newsitem.title: USA: O'Charley's names CEO Gregory Burns chair.
newsitem.headline: O'Charley's names CEO Gregory Burns chair.

text.p: O'Charley's Inc said Tuesday its board of directors had given the company's chief executive officer, Gregory Burns, the additional responsibilities of chairman and president.
It said the board also gave the secretary and treasurer, Chad Fitzhugh, the additional title of chief financial officer.
A company spokeswoman said Fitzhugh would replace Burns as chief financial officer, a post that he had to give up in order to take on his new reponsibilities.
She said Burns, who has been chief executive officer since 1994, would replace Charles McWhorter, who resigned earlier this month to pursue other business interests.
O'Charley's operates 69 casual dining restaurants in 10 U.S. states including Ohio and Tennessee.
